# Zapply Jobs — Internships 2027

> Curated internship listings for students — software engineering, data science, hardware, AI, business, and more. US-focused, updated continuously by an automated pipeline.

## What this repo provides
- A README internship table kept current by the Zapply pipeline: role, company, location, posting date, and direct apply link
- Summer, fall, spring, and co-op programs
- Part of the Zapply Jobs ecosystem (zapplyjobs)

## How to use
- Browse `README.md` — it is the canonical listing and regenerates continuously as the pipeline refreshes
- For search and filters, use the public boards: softwarejobs.dev (US tech, all levels) and zapply.jobs (US early-career)
- Apply links go directly to company career pages
- This repo is display-only: it intentionally contains no raw data files

## Related repos
- New Grad Jobs: github.com/zapplyjobs/New-Grad-Jobs-2027
- Software Engineering: github.com/zapplyjobs/New-Grad-Software-Engineering-Jobs-2027
- Data Science: github.com/zapplyjobs/New-Grad-Data-Science-Jobs-2027

## Who maintains this
Zapply Jobs (zapplyjobs) — automated pipeline with human curation
